items.title: Akamai Technologies (AKAM) Expands Mobile Enterprise Browser Security
items.summary: Akamai Technologies (NasdaqGS:AKAM) announced a new collaboration with Microsoft to secure Microsoft Edge for Business on mobile devices. The partnership targets iOS and Android, bringing enterprise browser controls such as real time threat prevention directly into Microsoft Edge for Business. Akamai says the integration also introduces generative AI governance features designed for corporate use of Microsoft Edge for Business on phones and tablets.
